Sources subsystem bottleneck due to individual file I/O

kb_entries.title: Data Storage Methods & AI-Optimized Storage Research

SQLite unbeatable for embedded structured storage
Vector DBs now infrastructure-level (Qdrant, Milvus lead)
Graph-enhanced vector retrieval emerging 2026 standard
CrewAI pattern: ChromaDB (short-term) + SQLite3 (long-term)
Hybrid search (dense vectors + BM25) doubles RAG accuracy
LMDB best read performance, RocksDB best write throughput

30% of recommendations never addressed (handoff tracking)

kb_entries.title: JSONL Message Bus: Technical Reference for Inter-Agent Communication
key_concepts: POSIX atomic write guarantees with O_APPEND
Keep messages under 4096 bytes for atomic writes
Use os.write() not buffered I/O for concurrent writers
Never use NFS for JSONL message bus
Polling at 100-200ms recommended over inotify
JSONL schema: id, type, channel, team, ts, body
Channel types: global, team-N, topic-name
No fsync needed for ephemeral agent messages
Epoch-based file rotation preferred over rename

kb_entries.title: SQLite WAL Shared State: Technical Reference for Inter-Agent Coordination
key_concepts: SQLite WAL mode: concurrent readers + single writer
Sub-millisecond read latency
BEGIN IMMEDIATE for write transactions
Schema for heartbeats, phase signals, rate limits, pub/sub
Auto-recovery via WAL checksums on crash
All processes must use same canonical path
Never delete -wal/-shm files while DB in use

kb_entries.title: Failure Mode Analysis: JSONL Bus + SQLite Shared State
key_concepts: 26 failure modes analyzed across 6 categories
3 critical must-fix issues: TOCTOU rate-limit race, git worktree split-brain, coordinator SPOF
2 should-fix issues: enforced data cleanup, startup validation
CONDITIONAL GO for prototype with 3 mandatory conditions
RC-4: check-then-increment must use BEGIN IMMEDIATE
SB-1/SB-2: communication files must be outside git worktrees
CR-3: coordinator needs watchdog/self-healing

kb_entries.title: Multi-Agent Communication Prototype: Dual Implementation & Test Results
key_concepts: Proto A (JSONL+SQLite): 1437 lines, durability-first
Proto B (pipes+mmap): 1855 lines, speed-first
113 tests all pass after 4 fix iterations
Proto A: 3 bugs found, Proto B: 7 bugs found
SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE more robust than manual mmap locking
Proto A recommended for production

kb_entries.title: Architecture & Integration Analysis: Live Communication System
key_concepts: File placement: storage/coordination/ in main repo root
Discovery via CLAUDE_COORD_DIR env var or git rev-parse fallback
Coordinator needs write access (departure from read-only pattern)
Incremental adoption: mixed operations supported
Python stdlib only, no external dependencies
Clean between operations (ephemeral state)
handoff_tracker complements, not replaces, live communication

kb_entries.title: Live Prototype Testing: Data Gathering Benchmark Results
key_concepts: Both prototypes pass all benchmarks (<1% overhead)
Proto A collects 16.7% more data via coordinated rate limiting
Communication adds ~0.3ms per message (negligible vs API latency)
Failure injection handled cleanly with graceful degradation
Synthetic benchmarks complement but don't replace live tests
Think tank phase produced actionable architecture plans

kb_entries.title: Think Tank Efficiency Analysis: Proto A Communication vs No Communication
key_concepts: Unanimous verdict: Proto A provides efficiency gains
Communication overhead <1% in all scenarios
16.7% more data collected with coordination
Sublinear scaling: larger teams benefit more
Failure detection saves 20-27% of operation time
Breakeven after first coordinated action (>99% probability)
Proto A marked production, Proto B archived
Dogfooding validated real-time cross-referencing value
